findings.text: The acceptance text still says "the engine correction", singular, but the commit adds a second planned execution change (mapped action targets). An implementer could treat the first one as the only correction. Fix: say "the engine corrections (mapped NULL and mapped action targets)".

The status says the mapped-NULL work is active and the action-target correction "follows task review". It does not say whether the action-target work has started. Fix: say that the action-target correction has not started and that it is waiting for the task review.
